_meta.notes: This is NOT the multi-page hand-filled form: it is the clerk's online 'summary_printer.cfm' printout, with the Summary table on page 1 (pages 2-3 are the itemized schedules). There is therefore no District Number field and no amendment question on the document (recorded null). Lines 1-2 and 4/6 are machine-printed; Lines 3, 5 and 7 are handwritten. The Summary has FOUR money columns - 'Total this Period'/'YTD' plus a second 'Total this Period'/'YTD' pair labelled 'Other Campaign Accounts', both $0.00 on Lines 1 and 2; the Other-Campaign-Accounts pair is not captured here. Line 7 is handwritten '$1857896' with no clear comma and an ambiguous decimal; the digits are unmistakable and the value is independently confirmed by the 2012 Year-End filing, whose Line 3 beginning balance is written '$18,578.96'. Report date taken from the printout footer (10/30/2012); the form carries no signature block. Column A arithmetic is consistent.

contributions.detail: exact (26 rows sum 25,650.00 = stated $25,650.00 = the printed 'Total Contributions $25,650.00' = Summary lines 1 and 4). The one in-kind row ($500.00 Banner Mania) IS included, as the printed total requires.

expenditures.detail: exact (23 rows sum 23,530.68 = stated $23,530.68 = the printed 'Total Expenditures $23,530.68' = Summary lines 2 and 6). The one in-kind row ($500.00 Banner Mania) IS included.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: This is the 2012 WEB-PRINTED slco.org form; it prints NO per-page subtotal line anywhere - only one 'Total Contributions' row at the end of the contributions table and one 'Total Expenditures' row at the end of the expenditures table. So p2 and p3 cannot gate individually and I say so rather than inventing one. Contributions gate on the schedule total: 26 rows 25,650.00 = printed 25,650.00 - PASSED. Expenditures gate across the p2+p3 pair on the schedule total: 23 rows 23,530.68 = printed 23,530.68 - PASSED. The p2 expenditure block alone sums 15,343.20 and the p3 block 8,187.48; neither figure is printed anywhere on the form and neither is claimed as a subtotal.
itemized.escalation_note: contributions table re-rendered as a 300 dpi band crop; expenditures re-rendered as 300 dpi band crops on BOTH pages plus two extra edge crops (p2 foot and p3 head) to prove no expenditure row falls in the page break unseen.
itemized.notes: DIFFERENT FORM: the county's WEB-PRINTED 'Financial Disclosure Report' from slcintranet/financialDisclosure (born-digital, printed 10/30/2012, header 'Jensen, Michael - Interim Report October 30, 2012', 3 pages), not the handwritten paper Schedule A/B. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: passed - contributions 26 dates / 26 names / 26 amounts; expenditures 23 dates / 23 names / 23 purposes / 23 amounts; the IN-KIND marker has its own 'In-Kind?' column at the far right and never appears in a date cell. GEOMETRY IS DELIBERATELY OMITTED on every row of this filing: the scan is skewed and the table rows are of unequal height (one to three text lines each), so I could not fix per-row bands to better than about half a row, and a wrong pointer is worse than none. Values, dates and the two gates are unaffected. This form has NO donor address column at all, so donor_city/donor_state are blank by non-existence (the cover's own address, phone, fax and email blocks are county-redacted with black bars). Contributions row 26 is an AGGREGATE line - the form prints the literal '$50 and under' as the contributor name, $250.00, Occupation/Employer 'Misc' - flagged needs_review, not a named donor. Filer spellings retained: 'LIttle Ceassars', 'Salt Lake Boards of Realtors'. The form also prints 'No Contributions Received from other Campaign Accounts reported for this period.' and 'No Expenditures of other Campaign Accounts reported for this period.' - honest zeros for the other-accounts columns. Summary lines 3, 5 and 7 are HANDWRITTEN onto the printed form ($16,459.64 / $42,109.64 / $18,578.96) while lines 1, 2, 4 and 6 are machine-printed; the handwritten arithmetic is internally consistent (16,459.64 + 25,650.00 = 42,109.64; 42,109.64 - 23,530.68 = 18,578.96).
